statement: The function returns a result r, and r = true if and only if there exists an integer k such that 0 <= k, k + len(s1) <= len(s2), and for every byte c, the number of indices j with 0 <= j < len(s1) and s2[k+j] = c equals the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(s1) and s1[i] = c. In words: s2 has a contiguous substring of length len(s1) whose multiset of bytes is exactly the multiset of bytes of s1.
preconditions: len(s1) >= 1, len(s2) >= 1, len(s1) <= 10000, len(s2) <= 10000, and every byte of s1 and s2 is an ASCII lowercase letter (97 <= byte <= 122).
